text:
maria: Quick proposal — introduce an optional 'compact' audit event format (v2) to reduce payload size and storage for high-volume streams. idea: keep canonical verbose event shape but allow a compact wire format with short keys and a schema version tag. sample: ```json
{"fmt":"c","ver":2,"t":1672531200,"a":"user:123","r":"create_repo","s":"ok","meta":"k1=v1;k2=v2"}
```

sam: neat. main concerns: does compacting remove fields we currently rely on for RBAC checks and replay? any field removal breaks server-side authorizers or downstream analytics.

oleg: +1 on checking RBAC. we use actor.email, actor.org_id, resource.type in a few guards. in compact form we can keep canonical names in the server and have a deterministic mapping. need to ensure KMS-wrapped actor IDs still surface the same identity claims.

alisha: KMS/PII note — if we pack actor info into a short token, we must keep the kms-wrapped blob separate or clearly marked. legal wants auditable plaintext mapping for compliance customers (even if encrypted at rest). cannot hide who performed an action.

maria: good points. proposal update: compact is strictly a transport/storage optimization. schema v2 compact messages MUST include an 'actor_claims' envelope with either plaintext fields or a kms_wrapped reference: ```"actor_claims":"plain:email=...,org=..." or "actor_claims":"kmsref:wrapping-id"``` so downstream validators can resolve.

sam: versioning strategy? semantic? i suggest numeric format versioning (ver=1,2) plus a compatibility flag: "compat":"full"|"compact". server should accept both and normalize to canonical internal representation.

oleg: normalization is fine but we need a migration plan for consumers: some customers ingest raw events into their SIEMs. they might expect the verbose shape. we should offer a conversion adapter (lambda/container) and a temp topic that replays both formats for 90 days. provide sample code in SDKs.

alisha: customer-facing validation — we must ship a validator UI and sample events to customer tenants so they can run their ingestion pipelines. product asks for a "compat-check" API that can accept sample payloads and report missing claims.

maria: rollout phases I propose:
1) design doc + schema registry entries (1 week)
2) SDK/server normalize + read/write both formats behind feature flag (2 weeks)
3) internal consumers opt-in to compact for low-latency streams (2 weeks)
4) public beta with opt-in tenant flag + compat-check API + conversion adapters (30 days)
5) default compact for new high-throughput topics and migration tooling for legacy (60 days)

sre-oncall: storage/observability: compact reduces bandwidth, but increases risk for debugability. make sure we keep an indexable canonical metadata shard per event (timestamp, actor_id_hash, resource_id, op) in the primary index so search/tracing still works. also add a sampling-header for telemetry: "x-audit-sample:full|partial|none" so ops can request full copies for trouble tickets.

sam: about rollbacks — if we remove fields later we must not break archived queries. recommend immutable version tag and server-side fallback to enrich compact events with historical mapping from canonical store. we should log a migration-compatibility warning when a consumer reads an event lacking expected claims.

oleg: KMS impact — key rotation: if actor_claims uses kmsref, rotations must not invalidate past events for compliance. we need an archival unwrap process to keep decrypted claim snapshots for compliance-locked tenants or provide an HSM-backed audit-read endpoint for compliance teams.

alisha: also include a customer opt-out for compacting if they need verbatim event payloads for their retention requirements. contract/legal needs this as an option.

maria: action items:
- oleg: draft mapping table canonical_name <-> compact_key + KMS reference patterns (due EOD tomorrow)
- sam: implement normalization shim and compat warnings in server (spike 3d)
- alisha: write customer-facing compat-check API spec and opt-out T&Cs draft (sync with legal)
- sre-oncall: ensure indexable metadata shard and add x-audit-sample header to ingestion API
- dev-bot: run internal validation tests whenever schema registry entry changes (CI gate)

dev-bot: Scheduled CI job created: audit-schema-compat-check against staging for ver=2 at 03:00 UTC daily.

maria: final Qs — anyone worried about telemetry sampling interacting with compact format (sampling losing fields)? we should guarantee the sampler can request "full" copy for a percentage of events.

sre-oncall: we'll add sampling controls in the ingestion API. default partial sampling = 1% full events. ops can increase for incidents.

sam: okay. i'll start the server shim PR and post the design doc link once ready.

maria: thanks all. i'll publish the design doc and schema registry draft in #eng-docs after lunch. :thumbsup:
